# MIHORA.TECH — Sovereign Engineering & Datacenter Infrastructure

> MIHORA.TECH (Private) Limited is an international sovereign systems engineering studio operating synchronized command hubs in London (United Kingdom) and Islamabad (Pakistan). Co-founded by M. Matti ul Hasnain (Principal Systems Architect) and Omema Iqbal (Operations Director), MIHORA unifies custom distributed software, zero-trust HSM cryptography, Tier III/IV bare-metal datacenter construction, OTDR-verified optical fiber networks (<= 0.03 dB mean splice loss), industrial SCADA automation, and 24/7 follow-the-sun SRE operations under single-contract custody.

## Five Core Engineering Divisions
- [Services Hub](https://mihora.tech/services/): Directory of all 29 registered technical capabilities across 5 engineering divisions.
- [01. Digital Systems Engineering](https://mihora.tech/services/digital-engineering/): Custom Go/TypeScript/React microservices, partitioned PostgreSQL, mTLS v1.3 API meshes, and full source transfer.
- [02. Automation & Applied Intelligence](https://mihora.tech/services/automation-intelligence/): Kafka/Temporal event orchestration, optically isolated industrial SCADA/Modbus bridges, and air-gapped private LLM inference.
- [03. Physical Datacenter Infrastructure](https://mihora.tech/services/physical-infrastructure/): 42U/48U seismic cabinetry, 2N ATS power distribution, 1.14 PUE hot/cold aisle containment, NVMe SANs, and OS2 fusion splicing.
- [04. Field Engineering & Dispatch](https://mihora.tech/services/field-engineering/): 4-hour emergency hardware break-fix SLA, multi-site SD-WAN rollouts, Fujikura core-alignment splicing, and Fluke DSX-8000 certification.
- [05. 24/7 Managed SRE](https://mihora.tech/services/managed-sre/): Synchronized London (UTC+0) and Islamabad (UTC+5) watchdesk observability with sub-15-minute P1 escalation.
